name: Skotizo

mechanics.name: Standard Attacks
mechanics.description: He alternates between a swipe up close and a magic attack at range, so backing off does not put you out of reach.
mechanics.counterplay: Pray against whichever he is using. He is weak to crush and to the arclight, which shortens the fight more than any prayer choice.

mechanics.name: Dark Altars
mechanics.description: Four altars stand at the corners of the room. While any is lit he takes reduced damage and heals himself back up.
mechanics.counterplay: Break all four before you commit to him. Fighting him with even one lit is what makes the kill drag.

mechanics.name: Reanimated Demons
mechanics.description: He raises demon spawns to crowd you while the altars are still standing.
mechanics.counterplay: Clear them or step away from them. They exist to slow you down while the altars heal him.

mechanics.name: Dark Ankou
mechanics.description: An ankou joins in alongside the demon spawns, hitting harder than they do.
mechanics.counterplay: Kill it before going back to the altars. It does more damage than anything else in the room bar Skotizo himself.

_note: SKELETON, NOT LIVE-VERIFIED. Ids come from Jagex's own gameval names rather than guesses, but nothing here has been confirmed in a live fight. Provenance: gamevals from runelite-api 1.12.35 (net.runelite.api.gameval.*), because this cache download ships an empty GAMEVALS index (idx24) and ScanGameVal cannot read it; npc names, models, sequences and extents from the live cache (revision of 2026-08-06). Jagex's internal name for this boss is CATA_BOSS 7286, not Skotizo, and the whole fight is laid out under that prefix, which is what makes this file better than it first looked. SKOTIZO_PET 7671 and POH_SKOTIZO_PET 425 are excluded. THE FOUR DARK ALTARS ARE NPCS, NOT SCENERY, which is the find that gives this fight's defining mechanic a real trigger rather than a stand-in. The cache holds CATA_BOSS_ALTAR_OPEN_N 7288 and CLOSED_N 7289, and the same pair for E (7290, 7291), S (7292, 7293) and W (7294, 7295). Only the four OPEN ids are curated as triggers: an altar that is already closed is one you have dealt with, and firing on the closed ids would unlock the mechanic for finishing rather than for meeting it. CATA_BOSS_MINION 7287 is the reanimated demon spawn and CATA_BOSS_ANKOU 7296 is the dark ankou; both are adds detecting on npc-spawn. Note the ankou's display name is 'Dark Ankou' and there is an unrelated npc 7036, 'Reanimated demon', which is not part of this fight and is not curated. THE BOSS HAS NO ANIMATIONS OF ITS OWN. Npc 7286's standing animation is 4675, DEMON_UPDATE_READY, so it reuses the reworked generic demon set wholesale, and DEMON_UPDATE_ATTACK 4678 is curated as its attack on that basis. That set has one attack sequence, which is why his melee and magic are one mechanic rather than two: splitting them would mean two rows detecting on the same animation and unlocking at the same instant. Because the animation is generic, the animation trigger is doing real work: an animation only matches when played by an npc the engine is currently tracking as this boss (docs/DECISIONS.md D17), so a nearby demon cannot false-positive, and the demon spawn's own preview animation 66 is the same generic DEMON_READY for the same reason. No projectile is curated: the cache names no CATA_BOSS or SKOTIZO spotanim. staticFallback is false on all four; whether the borrowed animations read has not been eyeballed in game. The collection log page is titled 'Skotizo', matching 'name'. The note above already explains why his melee and magic are one row rather than two.
